LESSON: READING 2.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING – LIBRARY SKILLS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we get information on something we want to understand more?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. trace specific reading materials from online or print sources

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills above.
2. Explain Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we get information on something we want to understand more?
2. Why is it important to use the internet safely and cautiously?
